limits: Fixed decoded-JSON projection; original Zod issues/error identity, object descriptors/global library configuration, async/exotic inputs unqualified.
Invalid roots use local SummaryResponseError. Other captured520669 variant is recorded, not behavior-qualified.
No backend financial math, price/history provider, wallet/session/owner proof, indexer/RPC, UI or React-query lifecycle.
Local HTTP adapter supports one attempt and scalar query values; no Ky retries/timeouts, original array encoding, cookie jar or contract-error wrapping.
Worker does not claim full app/Next/browser aggregate checks; shared validation is coordinated by root.
